text:
mira: Planning sync - need to finalize alpha gating + smoke checks for Optimize Toolkit pilot (batching/caching/quant recs + eval-alerts). Customers want a low-friction trial.

sam: Short checklist idea from eng: 1) API returns recs + cost/latency delta estimate; 2) measurement endpoint returns prefix hit rate and observed token savings; 3) quant report gives accuracy delta vs baseline and expected throughput gains; 4) alerting that maps to eval sets and can post to webhook/email.

leo: I'll supply a compatibility table with model families and which quant modes we consider safe (int8/int4). Will mark 'do not touch' list for models with known quality regressions.

anya: CS asks that every rec include a one-line rationale and a small confidence score. Pilot customers will not test black-box changes without that.

jordan: Sales requirement: canary route + automatic fallback to hosted model if p95 latency or error rate crosses thresholds. Need a documented runbook for rollback.

sam: Proposed minimal smoke test (example):

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/optimize/recs
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
  -d '{"route":"checkout-chat","seq_len":256,"model":"redwood-mx-7b"}'

Expected quick response (json): {"batching": {"strategy":"auto-window","batch_window_ms":10,"expected_p50_ms_delta":-18,"token_cost_estimate":"-22%"}, "cache": {"expected_prefix_hit_rate_delta":"+12%","measurement_endpoint":"/v1/optimize/measure/checkout-chat"}, "quant_report": {"mode":"int8","expected_accuracy_delta":"-0.8%","throughput_gain":"+2.6x"}, "explanation":"high prefix reuse + short seqs -> batching + prefix cache recommended"}

leo: Note: quant_report.expected_accuracy_delta must be explicit about metric (e.g., ROUGE-L or task-specific F1). We should include which eval was used.

anya: Pilot onboarding checklist (CS): onboarding doc, contact matrix, 2-week schedule, weekly checkpoints, dashboard with baseline vs pilot metrics, and one-button rollback instruction.

mira: For gating, I want concrete numeric gates: - no more than 2% negative delta on primary quality metric for pilot; - cost reduction >10% or latency improvement p50 >10% for batching/quant to be considered "value add"; - eval-alert triggers configurable with default 5% regression threshold.

jordan: AEs will accept pilots if we promise: canary + auto-fallback + SRE signoff. I'll get SLO targets per account.

sam: Implementation notes: rec engine MVP returns suggestions only (no auto-apply). Measurement endpoint will replay prefixes to estimate hit rate. Eval-alerts will consume eval job outputs and compare to baseline, then fire a webhook if delta > threshold.

leo: I'll wire a trimmed eval harness to produce the two quality metrics we agreed. That will let alerts be actionable out of the box.

anya: UX: include both a short JSON reason and a human sentence. Example: "explanation":"expected token savings 21% (detected repeated prompt prefixes)" and "reason_tags":["prefix-reuse","short-seq"]. That keeps pilot customers happy.

mira: Who owns what and dates?
sam: Rec API + measurement endpoint: owner=Sam, ETA 3w.
leo: Model comp table + eval harness: owner=Leo, ETA 2w.

anya: Pilot docs + onboarding + runbook: owner=Anya, ETA 1w.
jordan: I'll coordinate contract addendum and SLOs, ETA 1w.

infra-bot: infra-bot: scheduled maintenance window blocked for pilot deploy on 2024-06-15 02:00 UTC.

mira: Risk notes: quant guidance can accidentally encourage users to enable modes we don't support. Must be explicit: we provide recommendations, not automatic conversion. Also flag models with poor quant tolerance.

sam: Agree. We'll include an SDK flag: apply_recommendation=false by default. Pilot customers can toggle in dashboard after manual review.

leo: Alerting destinations: webhook, email, and internal Slack channel. We should include a severity label and auto-escalation if alert persists for >24h.

anya: CS acceptance criteria (short): 1) visible recs + explanations in API; 2) measurement endpoint with observed baseline vs pilot metrics; 3) dashboard for 2-week pilot; 4) rollback documented and tested; 5) eval-alerts firing correctly during trial.

mira: Final call: lock minimal alpha scope to: rec APIs (batch/cache/quant report), measurement endpoints, basic eval-alerts -> webhook/email/Slack, pilot dashboard stub, runbook + rollback. If no objections by EOD Friday we'll commit. React with :thumbsup: or list blockers.
